newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila c. bank offers one-day rrp at 22 pct.
newsitem.headline: Manila c. bank offers one-day rrp at 22 pct.

text.p: The Philippine central bank said on Monday it will offer one-day reverse repos at 22 percent.
It will accept placements until 3:00 p.m. (0700 GMT) today.
This effectively slashes the overnight borrowing rate to 22 percent from 25 percent.
This is the third cut in over two weeks since the central bank raised its overnight borrowing rate to a 2-1/2 year high of 32 percent on July 10.

The central bank had raised its rates to protect the peso from speculation caused by Thailand's financial woes. The peso was effectively devalued two weeks ago as the central bank hoped to end months of speculation which had taken a toll on its foreign currency reserves.
